LanguageData.Raven_Building_Foundry.label: (Raven) Foundry
LanguageData.Raven_Building_Foundry.description: A heavy-duty foundry specifically designed for smelting special Raven alloys. It is now connected to the Raven fluid industrial network for fully automated production. The interior is engraved with unique converging patterns that can maintain extreme temperatures during smelting and absorb free light energy.\n\nRaven Darkfeather Steel, Raven Corona Steel, Raven Shattered Sun Cores, and Raven Fusang tokens are all synthesized here.
